name: Vice City
description: Leonida's sun-soaked metropolis and the beating heart of the state: neon nightlife, beachfront excess, high-rise condos and a constant hustle for clout. The series' iconic city returns in a modern-day setting.
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Places) and Trailers 1 & 2

name: Vice Beach
description: Vice City's beachfront strip of pastel hotels, packed sand, muscle beaches and late-night parties. Featured heavily in both trailers.
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Vice City section) and trailers

name: Leonida Keys
description: A long chain of tropical islands stretching south of the mainland, linked by bridges. Laid-back on the surface, home to boat culture, fishing charters and drug runners operating off the coast. Jason Duval lives and works here.
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Places)

name: Grassrivers
description: Vast wetlands of sawgrass, alligators and airboats west of Vice City. A wild, humid frontier where the law thins out and the swamp hides plenty.
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Places)

name: Port Gellhorn
description: A faded Gulf Coast town of motels, strip malls and a weathered waterfront. Once a resort destination, now left behind by the boom elsewhere in Leonida.
realWorldInspiration: Florida Panhandle Gulf Coast towns (e.g. Panama City)
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Places)

name: Ambrosia
description: A small inland town dominated by its sugar refinery. Bikers, back roads and an industrial edge define Ambrosia's rural, working-class character.
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Places)

name: Mount Kalaga National Park
description: Leonida's northern wilderness: forested trails, rivers and off-road country for hunting, camping and anyone who wants to stay off the grid.
realWorldInspiration: North Florida forests (e.g. Ocala National Forest)
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Places)

name: Leonida Penitentiary
description: State prison where Lucia Caminos served time. Trailer 2 opens on Lucia in custody before her release.
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Lucia Caminos) and Trailer 1; map position is a community estimate

name: Only Raw Records
description: Recording studio and record label run by Boobie Ike and Dre'Quan Priest, home of the rap duo Real Dimez.
source: Business confirmed on the official GTA VI website (Boobie Ike / Dre'Quan Priest); its exact location in Vice City is unconfirmed

name: Port of Vice City
description: Cargo terminals, cranes and cruise berths on the Vice City waterfront, glimpsed in trailer skyline shots.
source: Community identification from Trailer 1 skyline shots; official name unconfirmed
